title: Nuevo Laredo's Operativo Carrusel Brings Hot Drinks and Blankets to People Out in the Cold
excerpt: With temperatures dropping in Nuevo Laredo, the city's Civil Protection and Fire Department is running Operativo Carrusel — early-morning rounds delivering hot drinks and blankets to people on the street and families waiting outside hospitals.
content:
With temperatures dropping in Nuevo Laredo, the city’s Civil Protection and Fire Department has stepped up its humanitarian rounds under Operativo Carrusel, bringing direct help to people exposed to the cold.

Starting in the early morning hours, crews are covering different sectors of the city to find and assist people living on the street, relatives of patients waiting outside hospitals, and anyone else exposed to the low temperatures.

As part of the rounds, staff hand out hot drinks and blankets to those who need them, aiming to provide warmth and reduce the risks of prolonged exposure to the cold, especially in the early morning and at night, when conditions are harshest.

The department said the rounds will continue as long as the low temperatures persist, with crews staying alert to weather conditions and needs across the city’s neighborhoods.

Officials also urged residents to take precautions as temperatures change: dress warmly, avoid prolonged exposure to the cold, and pay special attention to children, older adults and people in vulnerable conditions.

In an emergency, residents should call 911. The Civil Protection and Fire Department can also be reached at 712-8911, 712-2124 and 712-3030.

Sources: Noticiero de Victoria — “Implementa Gobierno de Nuevo Laredo Operativo Carrusel para Proteger a la Población ante las Bajas Temperaturas,” Nov. 26, 2026, https://noticierodevictoria.com/implementa-gobierno-de-nuevo-laredo-operativo-carrusel-para-proteger-a-la-poblacion-ante-las-bajas-temperaturas/
